title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 25
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 25: the musicians from the sons of Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun and their twenty-four lots.

questions.text: The sons of which three men were set apart to prophesy with harps, stringed instruments, and cymbals?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:1 says David and the captains of the army set apart certain of the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun.

questions.text: At whose order did Asaph prophesy?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:2 says Asaph prophesied at the order of the king.

questions.text: How many sons of Jeduthun are listed?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:3 lists the sons of Jeduthun and says they were six.
1 Chronicles 25:5 calls Heman the king's seer in the words of God.

answers.text: The captain of the king's army
The king's seer in the words of God

questions.text: How many children did God give to Heman?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:5 says God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

questions.text: What was the number of those instructed in singing to Yahweh, all who were skillful?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:7 says their number was two hundred eighty-eight.

questions.text: Who took part in casting lots for their offices?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:8 says they cast lots all alike: the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.

answers.text: Small and great, teacher and student alike
Only the eldest sons of each family

questions.text: For Asaph, to whom did the first lot come out?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:9 says the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph.

questions.text: For the second and third lots (Gedaliah and Zaccur), how many were counted in each, with the man's sons and brothers?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:9-10 says Gedaliah with his brothers and sons were twelve, and Zaccur with his sons and brothers were twelve.

questions.text: To whom did the twenty-fourth lot come out?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 25:31 says the twenty-fourth lot came out to Romamti-Ezer.
